about: AudioRecs starter catalog (2026-10-23): headphones (over-ear and on-ear, wired and wireless), wired IEMs and true wireless earbuds the makers sell now, read from the makers' own pages (sony.jp, apple.com, bose.com, us.sennheiser-hearing.com and sennheiser.com, audio-technica.com, beyerdynamic.com, audeze.com, mezeaudio.com, gradolabs.com, campfireaudio.com, kiwiears.com) and from the audio retailers headphones.com (HIFIMAN, Focal, Dan Clark Audio, Truthear, Final, Bowers & Wilkins) and linsoul.com (Moondrop, 7Hz, Simgot, Tangzu, Thieaudio, Dunu, Letshuoer, Tanchjim, KZ). One entry per model as the maker names it, with the generation when the name carries one (Sony WH-1000XM6, AirPods Pro 3, Sennheiser Momentum 4 Wireless); colours, limited editions and bundles are left out, and so are gaming headsets (GamingRecs covers those). Columns: shape = category (Headphones, IEMs, Earbuds), balance = form (open-back, closed-back, over-ear, open-ear) and weight = connection (Wired, Wireless) only where the name or page says it; core and surface are blank.
